subheader: The billing rules, as questions and answers
lead: Open rather than folded away: these are the lines a support team links to twice a day, and a closed disclosure hides its answer from the browser's own search.
note: The note says which rules apply to whom, and what overrides them.

rules.title: Each question is a heading
rules.bodytext: The rules are items of the band, so they take the third heading level and give the page a usable outline.

rules.title: Each answer is rich text
rules.bodytext: Which means an editor can set a paragraph, a list or a link inside it without the template growing a field for every case.

rules.title: The answers stay open
rules.bodytext: Find-in-page reaches them, printing keeps them, and a reader who arrives from a support e-mail sees the answer rather than a row to click.
